headline: How to level up fast in Palworld 1.0
title: How to Level Up Fast in Palworld | Best XP Tips | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want to level up fast in Palworld one point zero? The level cap is now eighty. Tip one: catch new species. Your first catches of every Pal give big bonus XP, so catch everything you see. Tip two: fight Alpha Pals and tower bosses, they give huge XP. Tip three: clear dungeons and enemy bases. Tip four: do your missions, they now give big XP rewards. And as you level up, push into new regions like Sunreach and the World Tree. What level are you? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 leveling tips: catch new species for capture bonus XP, fight Alpha Pals and tower bosses, clear dungeons and enemy bases, and complete missions. The level cap is 80.
